description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Mordekaiser''' gains [[File:Magic penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Magic penetration]] magic penetration.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Mordekaiser''' summons a claw in the target direction that grants [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area. After 0.5 seconds, it deals magic damage to enemies within and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|pulls]] them over 250 units.
description2.text: Active: Mordekaiser summons a claw in the target direction that grants sight of the area. After 0.5 seconds, it deals magic damage to enemies within and pulls them over 250 units.

leveling2.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 (+ 45% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Death's Grasp'' will still [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|pull]] even if '''Mordekaiser''' [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]]. * ''Death's Grasp'' will only be visible from the enemy team's perspective if it is at least 300 units into their [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]]. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
notes.text:
Death's Grasp will still pull even if Mordekaiser dies.
Death's Grasp will only be visible from the enemy team's perspective if it is at least 300 units into their sight.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
